data.outcome_summary: This OECD PISA 2022 factsheet summarizes performance of 15-year-old students in Ukrainian regions (18 of 27) on mathematics, reading, and science, using published PISA 2022 database estimates (including mean scores and proficiency-level distributions). It reports that students in these regions scored below the OECD average in all three domains and that smaller shares reached top proficiency levels (Level 5 or 6) and minimum proficiency across all three subjects (Level 2 or higher). The note also describes within-country gaps: socioeconomic status (ESCS) is associated with mathematics performance, with advantaged students outperforming disadvantaged students by 84 score points, and boys outperform girls in mathematics while girls outperform boys in reading. Beyond achievement, it reports student-reported belonging, discipline and support in mathematics lessons, safety and bullying experiences, parental involvement, and system-level features such as shortages of teaching staff and school autonomy. Because this is a descriptive reporting document, it does not provide ML model training, PV-handling methods, or missing-data procedures for an empirical predictive analysis.
